Schedule – A (Tender Condition) The Institute propose to lease the shop area in the Hostel 3 of IIT Bombay to the prospective successful bidder initially for a period of One year to provide fresh fruits and fruit juices as listed in Schedule D, as per the ‘scope of work’ given in Schedule B and ‘payment of charges’ as per Schedule C. Further the contract

Further the contract may be renewable for a maximuma period of three terms (one year each) on the basis of satisfactory performance. The interested bidder may submit the duly filled tender to the Incharge-HCU, Indian Institute of Technology Bombay, Powai – 400076 on or before 13:00 Hrs.

Bombay, Powai – 400076 on or before 13:00 Hrs. on 26/02/2024. An amount of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) towards Security deposit (EMD) in the form of Demand Draft drawn in favour of’The Registrar, IIT Bombay’ should be enclosed with Annexure I. without EMD will be summarily rejected.

without EMD will be summarily rejected. While EMD will be returned to the unsuccessful bidders within 45 days of award of the contract. The EMD will be returned to the successful bidder on submission of the Performance security.

Performance security. All the documents must be duly signed by the authorized signatory of the Tenderer. The sealed cover containing the tender should superscribed as ‘Tender for running a shop providing fresh fruits/fruit juice at Hostel 3 of IIT Bombay’. The sealed cover containing the signed Tender documents and

The sealed cover containing the signed Tender documents and Demand Draft for Rs.50,000/- towards EMD should be sent by speed/registered post at Hostel Coordinating Unit, Main Building, IIT Bombay, Powai, Mumbai – 400076. No interest is payable on EMD submitted. The Tender will be opened on specified date and time in the Conference room, Office of Dean (SA), Main

The Tender will be opened on specified date and time in the Conference room, Office of Dean (SA), Main Building, IIT Bombay. The Tenders received after the due date and time will not be considered. Bidders have to quote their bid in the prescribed format given at Annexure II. Successful L1 Bidder

Successful L1 Bidder will be considered on the basis of total offered price in Annexure II. Bidders are also requested to quote a bid for License fee in the prescribed format at Annexure III. In case of tie, offered License Fee

In case of tie, offered License Fee (Annexure III) will be considered for determining L1 bidder. The participating tenderers undertake to acknowledge that they have gone through all the Schedules and Annexures of this tender documents and agree to abide by them. The Tender Committee reserves the right to shortlist / reject any or all the Tenders and accept the whole or

The Tender Committee reserves the right to shortlist / reject any or all the Tenders and accept the whole or any part of a tender without assigning any reason therefore. Any legal disputes arising out of this tender process shall be settled in the court of competent jurisdiction located within the city of Mumbai, Maharashtra. The successful bidder shall execute an agreement with the IIT Bombay accepting the terms and conditions

The successful bidder shall execute an agreement with the IIT Bombay accepting the terms and conditions as listed in various Schedules. The agreement can be terminated by either side with a notice of one month.
SCHEDULE – B (Scope of Work) Operating area of 171 Sq. (13.12 ft. X 13.02 ft.) along with electricity supply will be licensed to the vendor.

to the vendor. The vendor has to arrange for all the equipment and furniture within the licensed area. The licensed area has to be returned, after the completion of the contract, without any damage. for repairs to damages, if any, will be adjusted in the Security Deposit. Operating Hours
Operating Hours 06:30 Hrs. to 09:30 Hrs. & 13:00 Hrs. to 03:00 Hrs.

to 03:00 Hrs. Self-service system with customers picking up the items from the counter of the vendor will be followed. The IIT Bombay will not provide chairs and dining tables in the dining area, that will be the responsibility of the vendor itself.

be the responsibility of the vendor itself. The vendor should provide the items in the right size / quantity / quality at the specific timings and at the rates prescribed. Also the vendor cannot use the garden area of Hostel 3 for setting up any furniture items.

garden area of Hostel 3 for setting up any furniture items. IIT Bombay shall provide the following: Water for washing and cleaning the area at the prevailing rates chargeable to commercial establishemnts Electricity for the exclusive purpose of running shop at the prevailing rates chargeable

Electricity for the exclusive purpose of running shop at the prevailing rates chargeable to commercial establishments. The vendor will use only good quality fruits, dairy products etc. The vendor shall use best quality fruits, milk etc.

fruits, milk etc. for preparing juices etc. vendors should not use any artifical colour, preservatives and other chemical additives in any of the juices or even store them in the shop. Following shall be the responsibilities of the vendor regarding hygiene and sanitation.

Following shall be the responsibilities of the vendor regarding hygiene and sanitation. Hygiene and sanitation standards should strictly comply with FSSAI regulations and/or prevalent norms. Compliance to the hygiene standards will be checked periodically. Non-compliance

Non-compliance to hygiene standards will be sufficient reason to terminate the contract or to levy suitable penalty. Cleaning and maintenance of equipment. Keeping the space provided neat, clean and hygienic. Pest Control measures in the shop area.

Pest Control measures in the shop area. Vendor’s performance will be monitored on a regular basis by the Eateries Committee and all recommendations/decisions of the Committee will be notified to the vendor which should be strictly complied with. Non-compliance with menu and serving unhygienic food can result in instant

Non-compliance with menu and serving unhygienic food can result in instant monetary fine/termination of contract or both. The rates quoted by the vendor shall be applicable for one year from the start of operations. The rates per item may be revised by a maximum of 5% or based on the percentage increase in the Consumer Price Index, whichever is lower, at the time of renewal of the contract.
the Consumer Price Index, whichever is lower, at the time of renewal of the contract. This will be done by the committee constituted by the competent authoritiy.

The vendor shall not assign, sublet or part with the possession of the licensed premises and properties of the Institute therein or any part thereof under any circumstances. On expiry/termination of the license, the vendor must vacate the licensed premises. All fixtures, furniture, etc.

furniture, etc. which are properties of IIT Bombay should be handed over to IIT Bombay in good and tenable conditions. Cost of repair charges for mishandling and willful damage (except normal wear and tear) will be deducted from the Security Deposit.

and tear) will be deducted from the Security Deposit. Any equipment of the vendor left behind beyond a reasonable time will be deducted from the Security Deposit. The vendor shall not construct or make any structural alterations inside the licensed premises. The vendor shall pay to the IIT Bombay the monthly licence fee and other allied charges, as

The vendor shall pay to the IIT Bombay the monthly licence fee and other allied charges, as specified in Schedule-C on or before 5th of every month, failing which a penalty as per rules for all the days up to the date of actual payment beyond 5th will be levied by IIT Bombay. An amount of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) towards Performance security should be paid by the vendor in the form of Demand Draft drawn in favour of ‘The Registrar, IIT Bombay’

paid by the vendor in the form of Demand Draft drawn in favour of ‘The Registrar, IIT Bombay’ before signing the Agreement. No interest is payable on the Performance security and the amount will be refunded within 60 days of the expiry/termination of the contract after adjusting dues, if any. The vendor should not employ any child labour.

The vendor should not employ any child labour. The vendor shall maintain a register with name, age and address of all his employees working in IIT Bombay campus. The vendor must report any changes in the list of employees immediately.

changes in the list of employees immediately. vendor shall arrange to obtain security pass for all his employees from the Security Section of IIT Bombay, giving due undertaking for their character and antecedents. No staff of the vendor can stay overnight in the IIT Bombay campus or beyond reasonable hours

No staff of the vendor can stay overnight in the IIT Bombay campus or beyond reasonable hours after, before closing or opening time of the Canteen The employees of the vendor should wear hand gloves, head gears while serving. employees should undergo a medical examination once in a year to validate their physical and hygiene The vendor should ensure that all of the employees are free of communicable diseases and

The vendor should ensure that all of the employees are free of communicable diseases and medical certificate of all the employees to this effect should be submitted before the start of the canteen service. The vendor shall be responsible for the proper conduct and behaviour of the employees engaged Smoking, consumption/distribution of alcohol, use of pan and gutka or any other banned or

Smoking, consumption/distribution of alcohol, use of pan and gutka or any other banned or restricted substances by the vendor or his employees of the vendor is strictly probibited. The vendor is solely responsible for the payment of minimum wages, ESI and EPF for their employees as per the rules of Maharashtra Government and should meet any other statutory and nonstatutory benefits/obligations. The record of duty hours and pay structure should be maintained as per

The record of duty hours and pay structure should be maintained as per rules of inspection by the Government authorities. The vendor should submit proof of having disbursed wages to the persons employed by them within 7 days on expiry of the wage period. The vendor should ensure regular submission of all monthly, half-yearly and yearly returns to the
The vendor should ensure regular submission of all monthly, half-yearly and yearly returns to the ESIC/EPF and other statutory organisations and a copy it to IIT Bombay.

The vendor has to maintain all books, registers, forms and other related documents which are prescribed under Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, 1971 and its Central rules, MinimumWages Act, 1948 and its Central rules, EPF & MP Act, 1952, ESI Act, 1948 and all other concerned Acts/Rules/Laws. Periodic cleaning of fixtures (including lights, fans and other equipment), removal of cobweb,

Periodic cleaning of fixtures (including lights, fans and other equipment), removal of cobweb, in the licensed area and dining area will be the responsibility of the vendor. Waste disposal is the responsibility of the vendor. All biodegradable food waste has to be bagged separately in leak-proof bags.

separately in leak-proof bags. Non-biodegradable waste has to be segregated at source (by not mixing with biodegradable wastes) and handed over to authorised personnel engaged by IIT Bombay. wastage should be thrown out of the windows of the shop area nor should be fed to the animals. Noncompliance of waste disposal rules will invite penalty.

Noncompliance of waste disposal rules will invite penalty. vendor, under no circumstances, shall dispose plastic and food waste into the drainage. Damages caused to the drainage system by breaking the jallies, etc.

jallies, etc. Which will result in charging of appropriate repairs will be recovered completely from the vendor and penalty theron. The vendor should hold the valid Central license under the Food Safety and Standards Act 2006 and ensure compliance of provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act and Regulations at all times.

and ensure compliance of provisions of Food Safety and Standards Act and Regulations at all times. The vendor should make his own arrangements for obtaining necessary license / clearance / approval from Corporation of Mumbai, Government of Maharashtra and for any other local authority, wherever necessary and IIT Bombay will in no way be responsible for any lapse by the vendor in this regard. Application for termination of license and vacating the premises should be sent by the vendor one

Application for termination of license and vacating the premises should be sent by the vendor one month in advance from the date from which he desires to terminate the license and vacate the premises allotted to them. The vendor shall deliver to the Institute, on the said date, vacant possession of the premises allotted to him, along with all its fittings, if any, in the same condition as it was when he

premises allotted to him, along with all its fittings, if any, in the same condition as it was when he took possession of the same. Similarly, IIT Bombay can terminate the agreement by giving one month’s notice to the vendor without assigning any reason.
